subject: Request: Trial runway adjustment for Lexicon Labs — build freeze
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@lexicon.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Alice Morgan <alice.m@lexicon.ai>, Contracts <contracts@lexicon.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Trial runway concerns — blocked by data pipeline

Hi Sofia,

Quick context: our engineers hit a blocker with the data connector to our ETL; the team expects the fix to ship in ~10 business days. We were hoping to run a 30-day POC with Redwood, but with the integration stall we won’t get meaningful signal in that window. Can Redwood extend the trial window (and a small sandbox quota bump) so we can finish the connector work and then run the main evaluation?

What would help:
- +2 weeks on trial end date (or a pro-rated extension tied to integration completion)
- temporary 50k token sandbox top-up to keep smoke tests running

We can share the SSO test account and an ETA from our infra lead once you confirm interest. We’d like a short note we can pass to procurement to justify the extension.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform Engineering, Lexicon Labs
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@lexicon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial runway concerns — blocked by data pipeline

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear the connector hit a snag. We’re committed to making the evaluation meaningful. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Can you share the estimated remediation date from your team? even a range (e.g., 10–12 business days) helps.
2) Can you provide a staging SSO/test account so our SEs can try the webhook/proxy workaround I expect Dev to propose below?

I’ll flag this with our CS and Sales Engineering teams now to scope a short extension and a one-time sandbox bump. Marissa — can you draft a formal approval for procurement and a note we can share with Lexicon? Dev — please advise whether a temporary hosted proxy will be acceptable.

I’ll follow up shortly with a formal confirmation.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@lexicon.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial runway concerns — blocked by data pipeline

Hi Samir,

Appreciate the details — and happy to help get procurement the paperwork they need. From our side we can approve:

- A one-time 2-week trial extension tied to the integration completion date
- A temporary sandbox quota top-up of 50,000 tokens for smoke tests

I attached the sandbox_quota_adjustment_form.pdf (internal form) and will create an approval memo you can share with Contracts. If you can confirm the remediation ETA and the SSO test account, I’ll generate a short procurement note and loop Neha from Finance if Contracts needs a cost justification.

Attachments: sandbox_quota_adjustment_form.pdf

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@lexicon.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial runway concerns — blocked by data pipeline

Samir / team — quick technical note: we’ve used a lightweight webhook proxy for similar connector issues. Workaround steps take ~1–2 business days to validate (adding a small staging ETL shim and pointing connectors to our proxy during tests). If Lexicon can provide a staging SSO test account and a sample log (or the webhook schema), we can get smoke tests running in parallel to your fix.

I’ve attached a sample weblog-sample.txt showing the minimal payload we need. If proxying isn’t acceptable for security reasons, please let us know and we’ll coordinate a secure alternative (mutual TLS or IP allow-list).

—Dev
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: weblog-sample.txt
From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@lexicon.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@lexicon.ai>, Alice Morgan <alice.m@lexicon.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial runway concerns — blocked by data pipeline

Thanks — that workaround sounds workable. We can:
- Provide a staging SSO test account by EOD Wednesday (creds in a secure transfer)
- Share webhook schema and a small sample log (will attach)

Procurement asks for a formal approval email that we can attach to their internal request — can Redwood send a short approval note that confirms the 2-week extension and the 50k token sandbox top-up? I’ll also attach the current SOW (SOW_v0.3.docx) so Contracts can keep the procurement thread moving.

Samir
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@lexicon.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial runway concerns — blocked by data pipeline

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround and for offering the test creds. Per Marissa’s note and after a quick review with Finance, we confirm the following:

- Redwood approves a 14-calendar-day extension to the current trial end date (extension to be set from the existing trial expiry).
- Redwood will provision a one-time sandbox token top-up of 50,000 tokens to Lexicon’s trial account for smoke tests.
- This extension is tied to the integration completion; once your team signals the fix is in staging, we’ll remove the temporary proxy and run the full test cycle.

I’m attaching a brief approval PDF you can share with procurement (approved-trial-extension-lexicon.pdf) and adding the HubSpot deal link to the thread. If Contracts needs a formal SOW sign-off before continuing, we’ll coordinate that separately — happy to help expedite the DocuSign.

Next steps:
1) Lexicon sends SSO staging creds and the webhook sample.
2) Dev validates smoke pass (1–2 business days).
3) Marissa sends procurement memo (copy to Contracts).

If anything changes, ping me directly.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: approved-trial-extension-lexicon.pdf
